SUMMARY
AI Powered Tech Talent. Build AI native enterprise applications on SAP Business Technology Platform (SAP BTP) by combining strong platform engineering (admin + solution design + full stack build) with agentic AI application patterns (LLMs + tools + retrieval + evaluation). This role is about building, deploying, and operating cloud applications on SAP BTP, and evolving them into intelligent systems through rapid prototyping and production hardening.

Core Responsibilities
1) Cloud Application Engineering on SAP BTP
  • Build, deploy, and manage applications in a cloud-based environment on SAP BTP, covering platform fundamentals, administration touchpoints, solution design, and both frontend and backend development.
    2) Full Stack Delivery (Frontend + Backend) with SAP BTP Patterns
  • Develop backend services and APIs (including CRUD + business logic + validations) using Node.js-based service patterns, and expose services for frontend consumption.
  • Build responsive UI components using SAPUI5 (XML views, controllers, MVC approach) and integrate with backend APIs for data display and write-back flows.
    3) Data Modeling Persistence Foundations
  • Design database artifacts and data models (tables/views/entities/relationships) and connect applications to SAP HANA-based persistence patterns used in BTP app development scenarios.
    4) Platform Setup Deployment Engineering
  • Configure subaccounts/service instances/roles and set up development spaces configure connectivity artifacts (e.g., destinations) for integrating external APIs and databases as part of application delivery.
  • Package and deploy applications using multi-target application (MTA) style deployment artifacts where applicable.
    5) AI Native Application Patterns (Agentic + LLM Integrated) (Build expectation)
  • Implement LLM-integrated features as part of BTP applications (e.g., assistant in the workflow ), including: tool calling, orchestration, memory/state handling, and safe action boundaries.
  • Build retrieval-grounded experiences (RAG-style) over enterprise content and APIs where the solution requires grounded responses, with clear fallback behaviors.
  • Create evaluation loops (offline test sets + online monitoring) so AI behavior changes are measurable and regressions are caught early.
    6) Engineering Excellence (Quality, DevOps, Collaboration)
  • Use Git-based workflows for source control and collaboration, and operate in Agile/Scrum delivery models.
  • Debug and resolve backend/database/service exposure issues encountered during full-stack delivery.

    Primary Skills (AI Native Must Have)
  • SAP BTP application development fundamentals spanning platform architecture, administration basics, solution design, and frontend/backend build.
  • Hands-on full-stack implementation patterns evidenced by: backend services + APIs + data models + UI integration.
  • Strong software engineering fundamentals (clean code, testing mindset, CI/CD orientation) and ability to move from prototype to production (AI native expectation).

    Secondary / Strongly Beneficial Skills
  • Practical exposure to common BTP app-dev tooling and patterns used in delivery environments (e.g., SAP Business Application Studio usage in full-stack build contexts).
  • Familiarity with structured learning paths such as BTP Application Development (training listing) and bootcamp-style enablement.
  • Awareness of platform building blocks and guidelines referenced in community materials like SAP BTP Developer s Guide .

    What This Role Does Not Center On
  • Not limited to AI-assisted development only this role owns AI behavior in the product (orchestration, grounding, evaluation, safety boundaries) as part of delivery (AI native expectation).
  • Not focused on training foundation models from scratch emphasis is on building agentic applications integrated with enterprise services.

    Value Delivered
  • Rapid delivery of cloud applications on SAP BTP with full-stack rigor (platform + backend + UI + deployment).
  • Higher-impact solutions by embedding agentic AI capabilities into business workflows while maintaining engineering discipline and operational reliability (AI native expectation).

    Additional Information
  • A 15 years full time education is required

    Qualification15 years full time education

jobDescription:
Project description
We are seeking an experienced Change Release Management Specialist to oversee and coordinate application changes and releases across multiple environments in a large enterprise services environment. The role focuses on managing the release lifecycle, ensuring smooth deployments, and collaborating closely with Release Managers, Application Teams, and Service Teams to support automation-driven processes. You need to have strong experience in release planning, process automation, configuration management, and enterprise-level deployments.
Responsibilities
  • Manage and coordinate all application changes and releases across non-production and production environments
  • Collaborate with Release Managers, Application, Platform, and DevOps teams to integrate automated release workflows
  • Support CI/CD-driven release pipelines and perform minor automation enhancements using Python and YAML, and implement runbook improvements
  • Ensure all releases follow change management policies, approvals, and audit requirements
  • Provision and manage cloud-based environments and containerized applications (Kubernetes, Docker/Podman) as part of the release process
  • Manage security and compliance scans (Checkmarx secrets, vulnerability checks, internal tools) as part of releases
  • Monitor logging and observability using cloud-native tools and Splunk
  • Maintain detailed documentation for releases, runbooks, automation processes, and SOPs
  • Perform ad-hoc operational, release-related, and automation tasks as required
  • Participate in shift-based support for critical releases or environments
  • Explore AI-driven automation and process improvements to optimize release reliability and efficiency
Skills
Must have
  • 5+ years of experience in Change Release Management for enterprise applications (IBM / financial services)
  • Strong knowledge of Release Management, Change Management, Configuration Management, and Problem/Incident Management
  • Hands-on experience supporting CI/CD pipelines and integrating automation workflows
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or similar) and containerized deployments (Kubernetes, Docker/Podman)
  • Ability to perform minor enhancements or scripts using Python and YAML in the release pipeline
  • Experience with source control systems (GitLab, Git) and build/deployment scripts
  • Solid understanding of databases (Oracle, PostgreSQL) and ability to integrate DB automation into releases
  • Experience integrating security and compliance scans into release processes
  • Experience with monitoring/logging tools (cloud-native + Splunk)
  • Experience documenting processes using Confluence, Jira, or similar tools
  • Familiarity with AI-driven automation concepts in release and deployment processes
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills
Nice to have
  • Understanding of ITIL processes is a plus

  • Bachelor??s degree in computer science, Engineering, or a related field.

NTT DATA is seeking a Junior PMO resource to provide day-to-day project coordination, tracking, reporting, and administrative support to the Procurement Team at client.   • Support the Procurement Leader with preparation for account reviews and internal meetings.

Meeting Stakeholder Coordination
  • Schedule and coordinate procurement-related meetings and follow-up sessions.
  • Prepare meeting agendas and supporting materials as required.
  • Capture meeting minutes, decisions, action items, owners, and due dates.
  • Follow up with action owners to ensure commitments are completed on time.
  • Coordinate with relevant NTT DATA teams and account stakeholders, including Procurement, Finance, Delivery, Operations, and other supporting functions as required.
Documentation Process Support
  • Maintain organized and up-to-date procurement documentation and working files.
  • Ensure trackers and reports contain accurate and current information.
  • Support collection and organization of quotations, approvals, purchase documentation, vendor information, and other procurement records.
  • Assist the Procurement Team Leader in standardizing trackers, templates, and routine processes.
  • Follow applicable NTT DATA and account processes for handling documentation and confidential information.
Required Skills Qualifications
  • Approximately 4+ years of experience in PMO, project coordination, procurement support, operations support, or a similar role.
  • Strong organizational and follow-up skills.
  • Good working knowledge of Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, and Teams.
  • Ability to maintain trackers and work comfortably with structured data.
  • Good written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to prepare concise status reports, meeting minutes, and action summaries.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple activities and deadlines.
  • Ability to work with stakeholders across different teams and levels of the organization.
  • Self-motivated and comfortable working with limited supervision once processes and expectations are established.
Preferred Skills
  • Previous exposure to Procurement, Vendor Management, Finance, or Supply Chain processes.
  • Experience supporting an enterprise client/account environment.
  • Familiarity with purchase orders, vendor onboarding, contract/renewal tracking, invoicing, or procurement approval processes.
  • Basic understanding of project management concepts, including actions, risks, issues, dependencies, and milestones.
  • Experience creating Excel-based trackers, reports, and simple dashboards.
Key Competencies
  • Ownership: Takes responsibility for assigned activities and follows them through to completion.
  • Attention to Detail: Maintains accurate trackers, documentation, and status information.
  • Follow-through: Proactively follows up on outstanding actions rather than waiting for updates.
  • Communication: Communicates clearly and professionally with internal and account stakeholders.
  • Organization: Effectively manages multiple requests, priorities, and deadlines.
  • Collaboration: Works effectively with Procurement and cross-functional teams.
  • Learning Agility: Quickly learns account processes, procurement workflows, tools, and stakeholder expectations.

The Junior PMO resource will be expected to support and maintain deliverables such as:
  • Procurement activity tracker

  • Design, implement and maintain long-running automated test scenarios (soak tests spanning days/weeks) using Spirent TestCenter APIs, covering performance, scalability, convergence, and protocol stability under sustained traffic load.

  • Collaborate with development team to translate software requirements into high-quality test automation suites
  • Develop automation for the end-to-end solution validation and integrate the automation for seamless validation.
  • Implement, execute and debug Python automated test scripts on Linux-based platforms
  • Analyze and manage automated regression test execution failures
  • Debug and troubleshoot complex issues and work closely with the engineering team on the failures and validate the fixes
  • Integrate test suites into CI/CD pipelines
  • Collaborate closely with hardware and software development teams to triage test failures and drive quality improvements
  • Reproduce and root-cause hardware/firmware defects through systematic test isolation
  • Make use of AI tooling (e.g. Claude Code, agentic AI) given customer-specific heavy usage patterns.
  • Review customer deployments and customer-found issues and address any gaps in the test coverage.
Skills Must have
  • Overall QA background of 6+ years, with 4+ years in testing networking domain-related applications.
  • QA Automation experience in an Agile/SCRUM team, focused on API and/or CLI testing (4+ years);
  • Python strongly preferred (other comparable languages considered).
  • Automated Testing for API or CLI 4+ years, including experience in test harness or framework development.
  • Hands-on experience automating Spirent TestCenter (STC) using its Python API specifically StcPython native API, the REST-based stcrestclient library (py-stcrestclient), or HLTAPI (High Level Test API); ability to script traffic port configuration, device emulation, traffic stream setup, result subscription and statistics retrieval.
  • Familiarity with STC Lab Server architecture: connecting to chassis, managing test sessions, and executing automated sequences without GUI dependency.
  • Experience writing and maintaining long-running automation suites (soak tests of days/weeks duration) with robust result collection, error handling, and reporting.

  • Practical experience with AI tooling in day-to-day activities to improve productivity and delivery quality (code generation, code review, automation, agentic AI, MCP usage, etc.).
  • Experience in performance, scale, and convergence testing; ability to analyze and improve performance and convergence at system level.
  • Ability to develop and publish solution validation documents and test reports.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills; able to communicate effectively across QA and Development teams.
  • Highly motivated, self-driven, and able to collaborate cross-functionally to meet challenging goals.
Nice to have
  • Knowledge Linux OS variants (Ubuntu, Debian).
  • CI/CD (Jenkins, GitLab, or similar) and issue tracking tools (JIRA, Confluence).
  • Knowledge of STC Tcl API or legacy Tcl/HLTAPI scripting (useful for migrating existing test suites to Python).
  • Familiarity with additional traffic generation or network testing tools (e.g., IXIA/Keysight, Wireshark, Iperf).

jobDescription:
Onelab Ventures is looking for an AI Product Manager who can drive the development of AI-powered products from ideation to launch and continuous improvement. The ideal candidate should have strong product management fundamentals combined with a practical understanding of Generative AI, LLMs, RAG, AI Agents, and AI workflows.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys working in a fast-paced startup environment, solving ambiguous problems, and collaborating closely with founders, engineers, designers, and users.

Key Responsibilities

Product Ownership

  • Define product vision, strategy, roadmap, and priorities for AI-powered products.
  • Own the complete product lifecycle from ideation development launch iteration.
  • Translate business and user problems into scalable AI-driven product solutions.
  • Identify opportunities to improve product adoption, engagement, and business outcomes.

AI-First Product Development

  • Design and develop products leveraging LLMs, Generative AI, RAG, and AI Agents.
  • Work on prompt design, AI workflows, automation, and AI-driven user experiences.
  • Collaborate with engineering teams on AI product and system architecture.
  • Evaluate AI capabilities and identify opportunities to integrate emerging AI technologies.

Execution & Delivery

  • Create detailed PRDs, user stories, acceptance criteria, and product documentation.
  • Drive sprint planning, prioritization, and timely product delivery.
  • Work closely with engineering and design teams throughout the development lifecycle.
  • Manage multiple priorities effectively in a fast-paced startup environment.

Data & Experimentation

  • Define and track product success metrics such as engagement, accuracy, retention, and adoption.
  • Conduct A/B testing and product experiments.
  • Optimize prompts, workflows, and AI experiences based on performance data.
  • Use user feedback and data insights to continuously improve the product.

Stakeholder Management

  • Collaborate closely with founders, engineers, designers, and other stakeholders.
  • Align product roadmap and priorities with overall business objectives.
  • Gather user feedback and translate insights into actionable product improvements.

Required Skills & Qualifications

Product Management

  • 26 years of experience in Product Management.
  • Experience in building and launching 01 or 1N products.
  • Strong problem-solving, analytical, and decision-making skills.
  • Ability to manage product priorities and drive execution independently.

AI / Generative AI – Must Have

  • Strong understanding of LLMs and Generative AI.
  • Familiarity with Prompt Engineering, RAG, AI Agents, and AI Automation.
  • Understanding of AI workflows and how AI capabilities can be incorporated into products.
  • Ability to work effectively with technical teams on AI-based solutions.

Technical Acumen

  • Ability to collaborate effectively with engineering teams.
  • Basic understanding of APIs, backend systems, integrations, and data flows.
  • Familiarity with AI APIs such as OpenAI or Anthropic.
  • Knowledge of LangChain or LlamaIndex will be an added advantage.

Product Tools

  • Experience with tools such as Jira, Notion, and Figma.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Prior experience working in a startup or fast-paced environment.
  • Experience with AI SaaS products.
  • Understanding of user behaviour and engagement in AI-driven products.
  • Engineering or technical background is preferred.
  • Experience working on AI/GenAI products from concept to launch will be an added advantage.

What We're Looking For

  • An AI-first thinker who focuses on solving problems rather than simply adding features.
  • Strong ownership and a bias toward execution.
  • Ability to convert ambiguity into clear, actionable plans.
  • Strong communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Data-driven approach to product decisions.
  • Curiosity and eagerness to learn and experiment with emerging AI technologies.

Client Success Story

How GrowthSpree Scaled BetterPlaces Pipeline with Multi-Channel Paid Ads

Multi-channel demand generation across Google, LinkedIn Meta that grew MQLs 273% and generated a pipeline in a single quarter.

  • Pipeline Generated:
  • MQL Growth (Jan-Mar): 273%
  • Lowest Cost Per Lead: 1,350
  • Best channel performance: Google Ads was the most consistent source of sales-qualified leads

The Mission

BetterPlace is a workforce management platform built for the industries that run on large, distributed, frontline teams construction, logistics, and retail. Its mission is to digitize the entire workforce lifecycle, from hiring and onboarding through attendance, payroll, and benefits, so that businesses managing thousands of workers can do it with speed, compliance, and transparency.

The Challenge

For a workforce platform selling into enterprise and mid-market accounts, a predictable flow of qualified pipeline is non-negotiable. BetterPlace partnered with GrowthSpree to take full ownership of its paid advertising across Google, LinkedIn, and Meta with a clear mandate: grow marketing-qualified leads, move them efficiently down the funnel, and bring cost per lead under control.

Key Challenges Identified

  • Volatile cost per lead: LinkedIn CPL was running extremely high early in the engagement.
  • Weak MQL SQL conversion: rising lead volume wasnt translating into qualified pipeline efficiently.
  • Multi-platform coordination: Google, LinkedIn, and Meta needed distinct, channel-specific roles.
  • Scale without inflating cost: more MQLs were needed but not at any price.

Baseline: Where BetterPlace Started

Baseline snapshot before the multi-channel paid program

  • Spend / channels: Google, LinkedIn, and Meta were running without distinct, coordinated roles, so spend overlapped instead of specializing.
  • CAC / cost per lead: LinkedIn cost per lead was running extremely high early in the engagement, inflating overall acquisition cost.
  • Conversion rate: Rising MQL volume wasnt converting efficiently into qualified pipeline a weak MQL-to-SQL handoff.
  • Tracking issues: Attribution had to be rebuilt with clean conversion tracking across all three platforms, so decisions could follow pipeline quality rather than vanity metrics.

Our Strategy

We treated each channel as a specialist, not a duplicate. Google would carry high-intent, bottom-of-funnel demand and protect SQL quality. LinkedIn would target BetterPlaces ICP and scale MQL volume through stronger creative. Meta would drive cost-efficient reach and top-of-funnel volume. Underpinning all of it: tight tracking and a relentless focus on lead quality, not just lead count.

The GrowthSpree Approach

GrowthSpree took over BetterPlaces full paid stack across Google, LinkedIn, and Meta. We rebuilt targeting around high-intent and competitor keywords on Google, refined audiences and creative on LinkedIn including testimonial-video creative that lifted performance and used interest-based targeting on Meta to unlock low-cost volume.

Every channel was instrumented for clean attribution through GA and GTM events, heatmap tracking, and pixel integration so optimization decisions were driven by qualified-pipeline signals, not vanity metrics.

Strategy at a Glance

Campaigns

Each channel a specialist: Google for high-intent BOFU demand and SQLs, LinkedIn for ICP-targeted MQL volume, Meta for cost-efficient top-of-funnel reach.

Bidding budget

Concentrated spend where each channel was strongest high-intent and competitor keywords on Google, and interest-based Meta campaigns to unlock low-cost volume.

Landing pages creative

New creative including testimonial videos on LinkedIn, plus tighter lead qualification to turn rising MQL volume into sales-ready pipeline.

Tracking

GA and GTM events, heatmap tracking, and pixel integration for clean attribution so every MQL, SQL, and SAL traced back to source.

How GrowthSpree Saved the Day

Google Ads

Google carried bottom-of-funnel demand. We focused on high-intent and competitor keywords to capture buyers actively evaluating workforce platforms making Google the most consistent source of sales-qualified leads across the quarter.

  • BOFU Focus
  • High-Intent + Competitor Keywords

LinkedIn Ads

LinkedIn became BetterPlaces MQL engine. By tightening ICP targeting and testing new creative including testimonial videos we scaled MQL volume sharply while cutting LinkedIn cost per lead by roughly 85% from January to February.

  • 85%
  • LinkedIn CPL Reduction (Jan Feb)

Meta (Facebook) Ads

Meta delivered the highest lead volume at the lowest cost. Interest-based targeting opened up cost-efficient top-of-funnel reach.

Job Title: Senior AI Security Researcher - Agent Identity Security (AIS)

Location: Bangalore, Coimbatore

Experience: 4+ years

AppViewX is the only machine and agent identity security company built for the AI and quantum era, bringing together discovery, automation, control, and intelligence. The AVX Platform helps enterprises reduce risk by providing complete visibility and governance over every machine and AI agent identity, automating their lifecycle, controlling their access, and proving compliance at the speed business demands. Trusted by global enterprises across financial services, healthcare, and technology, AppViewX is recognized as a leader in the IDC 2026 MarketScape for Certificate Lifecycle Management and KuppingerCole s 2025 Non-Human Identity Management Leadership Compass. For more information, users can visit appviewx.com.

Our Values:

At AppViewX, our values reflect how we work together in practice-not just what we aspire to. They show up in everyday decisions, how we collaborate across teams, and how we treat each other while building and delivering our work. If these values resonate with you, you ll likely feel at home here.
- Clarity: We interact with transparency, simplicity, and shared purpose.
- Unity: We build unity through mutual respect, trust, and collaboration.
- Innovation: We stay curious, challenge assumptions, and drive continuous improvement.

- Precision: We bring accuracy, consistency, and care to everything we do.

Role Overview

We are looking for an experienced AI Security Researcher to lead deep technical research for the Agent Identity Security (AIS) platform.

This research-focused role continuously explores the evolving AI and Agentic AI security landscape and translates findings into actionable security intelligence, prototypes, technical recommendations, and thought leadership for AIS.

The researcher will focus on AI agents, Agentic AI frameworks, MCP and emerging agent protocols, LLM security, AI identity, tool security, AI supply-chain risks, prompt and context security, and AI governance standards. The role will also continuously evaluate competitive products and emerging technologies to identify new threats, capabilities, and opportunities relevant to AIS.

A critical responsibility of this position is to serve as an independent security research function for AIS, continuously challenging the platform architecture, integrations, gateways, policy enforcement mechanisms, and agent interactions to ensure AIS remains secure as the AI ecosystem evolves.

The ideal candidate combines a strong security research mindset with hands-on technical ability and can move from research threat hypothesis experimentation PoC security recommendation product influence publication.

What will you be responsible for

  • Lead AI Security Research: Conduct continuous research into emerging threats across LLMs, AI agents, autonomous systems, Agentic AI platforms, MCP servers, AI tools, models, AI gateways, and AI development environments.
  • Research Agentic AI Attack Surfaces: Identify and analyze vulnerabilities involving prompt injection, indirect prompt injection, tool poisoning, excessive agency, insecure tool execution, privilege escalation, credential exposure, data exfiltration, memory poisoning, context manipulation, agent impersonation, and cross-agent attacks.
  • Research AI Identity Security: Investigate security challenges associated with human-to-agent, agent-to-agent, agent-to-tool, agent-to-MCP-server, and agent-to-model identities, including authentication, authorization, delegation, impersonation, credential management, and non-human identities.
  • Evaluate Emerging AI Protocols: Research new protocols and standards supporting AI and autonomous agents, including Model Context Protocol (MCP), Agent-to-Agent (A2A) protocols, agent communication standards, tool protocols, identity standards, and emerging interoperability frameworks.
  • Build Research PoCs: Develop working proof-of-concepts for emerging AI protocols, frameworks, security controls, attack techniques, and defensive mechanisms to validate their relevance to AIS.
  • Perform Adversarial Security Research: Build controlled attack scenarios against AI agents, MCP servers, tools, models, and gateways to understand realistic attack paths and determine how AIS should detect, prevent, or govern them.
  • Continuously Test AIS Security: Independently evaluate AIS architecture, APIs, agent integrations, MCP Gateway, policy enforcement, hooks, SDKs, credentials, authentication flows, and other security-sensitive components for potential weaknesses.
  • Drive Security-by-Research for AIS: Identify security gaps before they become customer or production risks and provide engineering teams with clear technical findings, attack scenarios, severity assessments, and recommended mitigations.
  • Perform Competitive Security Analysis: Continuously research competing and adjacent products across AI security, AI governance, AI-SPM, MCP security, identity security, cloud security, and Agentic AI security.
  • Maintain Competitive Intelligence: Compare competitor capabilities, architectures, security approaches, integrations, research publications, patents, product releases, and positioning against AIS and identify opportunities for technical differentiation.
  • Track Emerging Threats: Monitor security research, vulnerabilities, CVEs, attack techniques, academic publications, security conferences, open-source projects, and industry developments relevant to AI and Agentic AI.
  • Research AI Security Standards: Track and evaluate standards and frameworks including OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications, OWASP Agentic AI guidance, MITRE ATLAS, NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001, AIUC-1, and other emerging AI security and governance standards.
  • Map Research to AIS Capabilities: Translate newly identified attack techniques and security risks into potential AIS posture checks, policies, detections, risk indicators, compliance mappings, and security controls.
  • Create White Papers: Author technically rigorous white papers covering AI security threats, Agentic AI security, MCP security, AI identity, governance, emerging protocols, attack techniques, and AIS security approaches.
  • Publish Technical Research: Produce security advisories, technical blogs, research reports, attack demonstrations, architecture recommendations, and other technical thought-leadership content.
  • Develop Threat Models: Create and continuously evolve threat models for AI agents, MCP ecosystems, AI gateways, models, tools, credentials, memory systems, RAG pipelines, and autonomous workflows.
  • Create AI Security Taxonomies: Develop reusable classifications for Agentic AI threats, attack techniques, vulnerabilities, identities, security controls, and defensive mechanisms.
  • Collaborate with Engineering and Product: Present research findings to architects, engineering teams, security teams, and product management and help translate validated research into future AIS capabilities.
  • Support Customer Security Discussions: Provide deep technical expertise for strategic customer discussions, security workshops, research briefings, and complex questions around AI and Agentic AI security.
  • Represent AIS Research: Contribute to external technical communities through research papers, responsible disclosures, standards discussions, conference submissions, technical demonstrations, and open-source initiatives where appropriate.

What do we require

  • 4+ years of cybersecurity experience, with significant experience in security research, application security, cloud security, offensive security, identity security, vulnerability research, or related disciplines.
  • Demonstrated research experience in AI/ML security, LLM security, Agentic AI security, application security, identity security, or emerging cybersecurity technologies.
  • Strong understanding of LLMs, AI agents, Agentic AI frameworks, RAG systems, tools/functions, memory, context management, AI gateways, and model APIs.
  • Hands-on knowledge of MCP and emerging AI/agent protocols, with the ability to independently build clients, servers, integrations, attack scenarios, and security PoCs.
  • Strong understanding of AI attack techniques including prompt injection, tool poisoning, data exfiltration, insecure output handling, excessive agency, memory manipulation, supply-chain attacks, and privilege escalation.
  • Strong knowledge of authentication, authorization, OAuth/OIDC, API security, IAM, workload identities, secrets, tokens, credentials, RBAC/ABAC, and zero-trust principles.
  • Strong hands-on programming capability in Python, with the ability to rapidly build research tools, attack simulations, protocol implementations, automation, and PoCs.
  • Experience with security testing and research tools across web applications, APIs, cloud infrastructure, containers, identity systems, and distributed applications.
  • Familiarity with major AI ecosystems and platforms such as OpenAI, Anthropic, Microsoft Copilot, Google Gemini, AWS Bedrock, Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Salesforce Agentforce, and other emerging agentic platforms.
  • Knowledge of security and AI frameworks such as OWASP, MITRE ATT&CK/ATLAS, NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001, and emerging Agentic AI security standards.
  • Ability to independently read and analyze research papers, specifications, protocol definitions, standards, open-source implementations, and security advisories and determine their relevance to AIS.
  • Strong technical writing skills with demonstrated ability to produce white papers, research reports, vulnerability reports, technical blogs, threat models, or academic publications.
  • Experience performing competitive technical analysis and converting findings into actionable recommendations for engineering and product teams.
  • Strong analytical mindset with the ability to challenge assumptions, formulate attack hypotheses, design experiments, and validate findings through reproducible research.
  • Ability to work independently on ambiguous and emerging security problems where established security patterns or industry standards may not yet exist.
  • Published security research, CVEs, responsible disclosures, patents, academic papers, conference presentations, open-source security tools, or contributions to security/AI standards are strongly preferred.

Expected Research Outcomes

We will measure success primarily by research impact rather than feature delivery. Expected outcomes include:

  • Identification of new AI and Agentic AI attack techniques relevant to AIS.
  • Research-backed recommendations that improve the security architecture of AIS.
  • Working PoCs for emerging AI protocols, threats, and defensive techniques.
  • New security posture checks, policies, detections, or controls proposed from validated research.
  • Regular competitive intelligence identifying technical gaps and differentiation opportunities.
  • High-quality white papers, technical publications, threat models, and research reports.
  • Identification and responsible remediation of security weaknesses within AIS.
  • Contributions to industry discussions, standards, open-source initiatives, patents, or original security research.
  • A continuously maintained AIS AI Security Research Roadmap covering emerging protocols, threats, standards, competitors, and research priorities.

AppViewX caters to a wide range of customers from Fortune 1000 companies, including six of the top ten global commercial banks, five of the top ten global media companies, and five of the top ten managed healthcare providers. Over the years, we grew our diverse team, perfected our automation platform, and expanded our global footprint to India, North America, United Kingdom, and Australia.   • Contribute to the design and development of AI agents that autonomously detect, diagnose, and remediate operational issues across bare metal servers and virtual machines, helping reduce repetitive human toil
  • Identify and help eliminate TOIL by documenting manual operational workflows and contributing to intelligent, event-driven automation pipelines powered by LLMs and agentic frameworks (e.g., LangChain, AutoGen, CrewAI, or custom-built solutions)

  • Participate in incident analysis for operational events, leveraging AI tooling to help accelerate resolution and contribute to post-incident reviews
  • Collaborate with a globally distributed team of engineers to learn best practices, contribute to shared automation solutions, and grow your technical expertise

  • Write and maintain technical documentation for automation systems, agent workflows, and operational runbooks

What You'll Need:

  • Bachelors degree and/or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field
  • 5+ years of experience in software engineering, with exposure to systems and infrastructure concepts
  • 5+ years of hands-on experience in one or more of: Python, Go, Java, C++, with Python strongly preferred for AI/ML and agent development

Youll be at the intersection of AI and infrastructure at one of the most impactful cybersecurity companies in the world, with senior engineers and architects invested in your development.

About Tristone Strategic Partners LLP- Tristone Strategic Partners is a financial services firm based in Mumbai that provides investments and accounting-related support services and advisory services to international clients such as various investment funds, hedge funds, wealth management firms, start-ups corporates located across different geographies.

About the role- Tristone is embedding agentic AI directly into its workflows and systems. As a member of the Agentic AI engineering team, you'll help build agents, MCP servers, and evaluation loops that make AI generated code reliable, auditable, and fast to ship. You'll work closely with senior members of Tristone to deliver pragmatic, high-impact AI integrations at scale.

Key Responsibilities

  • Designing, building, and deploying AI-powered tools, agents, and workflow automations for use across the firm.
  • Working hands-on with the Claude ecosystem - Cowork, Claude Code, Connectors, Skills, and Plugins - alongside other AI platforms (ChatGPT, Gemini, and others).
  • Owning the end-to-end deployment lifecycle for AI tools and agents, including packaging, testing, hosting, and monitoring in production.
  • Collaborating with teams across the firm to identify opportunities to automate repetitive or manual processes using AI and workflow orchestration tools.
  • Reviewing and validating AI-generated outputs to ensure accuracy, completeness, and reliability before they reach internal or client-facing use.
  • Staying current on evolving AI capabilities and evaluating new tools and platforms for potential adoption.
  • Documenting technical approaches clearly and communicating outcomes to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Exercising sound judgement across AI workflows: assessing which client and fund data may be sent to which model, working exclusively through approved endpoints and enterprise tooling, and upholding the confidentiality obligations expected in a financial services environment.
  • Complying with IT policies and procedures.
  • Maintaining the security of information at all times.

Requirements

  • AI Tools LLMs - Hands-on experience using platforms such as Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, or Copilot, with the prompt-engineering skill to get consistent, high-quality outputs across models.
  • Agents and MCP - Hands-on experience building agentic workflows and integrating external tools through MCP servers or equivalent tool-use frameworks. Alongside this, a systematic approach to validating model output: maintained eval sets, regression checks before release, and structured human review loops, rather than ad-hoc spot checking.
  • Demonstrated Projects - Self-built AI projects or agents you can showcase, covering both standard and custom workflow-specific use cases. Projects built with Claude (Cowork, Claude Code, Connectors, Skills, Plugins) are particularly valued.
  • Prompt Engineering - Ability to structure prompts effectively - framing tasks clearly, refining outputs, and adapting instructions to get consistent, high-quality results across different AI models.
  • Build Deploy - Experience taking an AI tool or agent from build to production; packaging (Docker), hosting, and monitoring in a real environment.
  • Technical Skills - Python for scripting, API calls, and data pre-processing; SQL for querying structured data; React for simple internal dashboards; AI coding tools such as Claude Code or ChatGPT Codex.
  • Communication Collaboration - Good communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across teams and explain technical work clearly to non-technical stakeholders.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor or Master degree in computer engineering, Computer Science, or any other relevant specialization (e.g., AI/ML, Data Science, IT).

Experience

  • 1+ years of relevant experience in AI/ML engineering, software development, or applied AI projects.
  • You should be able to clearly demonstrate how you have used AI tools - including Claude - to build, deploy, and improve efficiency, quality, or speed in a professional context.

Job Type

  • Full time

Location

  • Mumbai, Maharashtra, India

descriptionFromApi:
THE ROLE
You will build the systems behind our internal AI intelligence layer and our client AI work. This is applied engineering on production systems with real users inside the company and real clients outside it. It is not a research post, and it is not a prompt writing post.
The work is varied by design. In a given quarter you might tune a retrieval pipeline that is returning the wrong chunks, design an authorisation model so an agent cannot read what its caller cannot read, benchmark two open weight models on a clients data to justify an on premises deployment, and then write the evaluation harness that proves the change was actually an improvement.
WHAT YOU WILL DO
- Build and maintain retrieval pipelines, covering chunking strategy, embedding selection, vector store performance and hybrid search behaviour. We run pgvector on PostgreSQL today.
- Design and ship agent workflows and tool calling systems, with attention to failure handling, cost and latency rather than demo quality output.
- Own model evaluation. Build the harnesses, define the metrics and produce the evidence that a change helped. We would rather have an unglamorous eval suite than a confident opinion.
- Deploy and operate inference workloads on GCP and Vertex AI, and contribute to sizing and configuration for on premises open weight model hosting.
- Integrate AI capability into the wider product surface through APIs, webhooks and event driven pipelines.
- Work with the AI Product Owner to turn requirements into technical designs, and push back when the requirement and the technology disagree.
WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR
- Strong Python, and comfort in a production codebase rather than only in notebooks.
- Practical experience with LLM applications: RAG systems, agent frameworks, structured output, function calling. You have debugged a retrieval system that was quietly returning rubbish, and you know how you found it.
- Solid SQL and PostgreSQL. Vector database experience is a clear advantage.
- Cloud deployment experience, ideally GCP, including containerised services and managed inference.
- An empirical instinct. When something improves, you want to know by how much.
USEFUL BUT NOT ESSENTIAL
- Fine tuning or adapter work, including LoRA.
- Experience with self hosted open weight models and GPU infrastructure.
- Familiarity with AI security concerns such as prompt injection, authorisation in retrieval, and data leakage across contexts.
- Frontend competence in React or Next.js, enough to build a working interface for your own systems.
WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE
In your first ninety days you will ship one meaningful improvement to retrieval quality on the internal AI platform with measurement to back it, and take independent ownership of at least one client facing AI component.

THE ROLE
This role sits between the people who need something and the people who build it. You will own discovery, requirements and delivery rhythm for AI features across our internal AI intelligence layer, our internal operating platform and client engagements, with product leadership setting direction and you running the execution.
AI product work differs from standard product work in one important way: the output is probabilistic. A feature is not simply built or not built, it is built to a quality level that has to be defined, measured and defended. A good part of this job is making that definition concrete enough for an engineer to build against and an executive to sign off on.
WHAT YOU WILL DO
- Run discovery with internal teams across operations, finance, HR, creative and PMO to find where AI genuinely removes work rather than adding a layer over it.
- Write product requirement documents that engineers can build from without a follow up meeting, including acceptance criteria that account for model behaviour rather than assuming deterministic output.
- Own and prioritise the backlog for AI features across both internal platforms, and run sprint ceremonies for the pod.
- Define and track adoption and impact metrics. If a feature ships and nobody uses it, that is yours to surface and fix.
- Support client engagements with requirement gathering, scope documentation and stakeholder communication.
- Coordinate user acceptance testing, rollout, internal enablement and documentation.
WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR
- Three or more years in product ownership, business analysis or a comparable delivery role, with at least one year on technically substantial products.
- Genuinely strong written communication. A large share of this job is documents, and they need to be unambiguous.
- A working understanding of how LLM products behave, including why they fail and what that means for scoping. You do not need to build them, but you cannot treat them as a black box that either works or does not.
- Confidence with stakeholders more senior than you, including the ability to say a request is not feasible and explain why.
- Comfort with ambiguity. Requirements here often begin as a vague complaint about a process.
USEFUL BUT NOT ESSENTIAL

- Experience with internal platform or enterprise tooling products, where adoption is the hardest problem.
- Exposure to AI governance, data privacy or access control requirements.
- Basic SQL, enough to answer your own questions about usage data.

Company Overview

At FoodChain ID, we are driven by our vision to make it easier to keep the food supply chain safe and transparent. Job Title: Business Analyst and Product Commercialization Lead

Reports To: Director, Product and Delivery Enablement

Location: Remote

Job Type: Full Time

Job Overview

The Business Analyst and Product Commercialization Lead works as part of the Product Management team supporting FoodChain IDs Enterprise Solutions portfolio, which includes Formulation for PLM, Compliance Analysis, and Recipes & Specifications. The role covers the two stretches of work that sit on either side of development: getting work ready to build, and getting built work ready to deliver.

On the front end, the role develops the epics, features, user stories, and acceptance criteria that carry an idea into a development-ready state, working day to day with the Product Management team, which sets feature scope and prioritization. Doing this well means understanding the product domain deeply enough to write requirements engineering can build from without a second round of clarification.

On the back end, the role makes sure that what development delivers is ready for customers: owning release communication, producing and maintaining product documentation, and building the training and services enablement assets that Services, Support, and Sales need to put new functionality to work. Consistent use of AI tooling is expected, including building and refining agent skills that reduce the manual effort of keeping documentation and release content current as features ship.

Key Responsibilities

Requirements Definition and Development Readiness

- Develop epics, features, and user stories from product direction, customer input, and conversations with subject matter experts (SMEs), working under the direction of the Product Management team, which owns feature scope and prioritization.

- Author clear, testable acceptance criteria, and confirm shared understanding with engineering and QA before work is committed to a sprint.

- Conduct the upfront research and analysis that makes story-writing and refinement sessions productive, so that decisions rest on evidence.

- Work closely with SMEs, Services, and business partners to understand the product needs behind a request, and translate them into requirements a development team can build from.

- Review or create process and system flow maps documenting the business domain, including the business rules and logic needed to incorporate a process into the system.

- Identify and document story dependencies to support refinement and sequencing.

- Maintain a regular cadence for story definition, writing, review, and refinement, keeping a backlog of sufficient depth and readiness to support team velocity.

- Participate in backlog refinement, sprint planning, and demos as the analyst closest to the requirements.

Delivery Coordination

- Track development progress against committed plans so that commercialization work is timed to when functionality will land.

- Raise scope changes, emerging gaps, and at-risk dates to the Product Management team early, with the specifics needed to make a decision.

- Review delivered functionality against acceptance criteria before it is considered ready for customers, and flag discrepancies.

- Contribute delivery and release content to the recurring account reporting and business reviews prepared by product leadership.

Release Communication

- Own release communication end to end: build and operate a repeatable process that captures release content as it is developed.

- Write release notes for every release, translating technical changes into language customers can act on, and publish them on a predictable cadence.

- Brief Services, Support, and Sales ahead of customer-visible changes so that internal teams are never behind the customer.

- Coordinate the timing of release communication with documentation and enablement updates so that customers and internal teams encounter a consistent picture.

Product Documentation

- Own the customer documentation portal as its primary author and editor, and keep published content aligned with shipped functionality.

- Drive documentation updates from the same source that drives release notes, so that both are produced from one pass through each release.

- Improve the structure and quality of existing documentation over time, prioritizing the areas where support escalations and customer questions indicate confusion.

- Establish and maintain standards for voice, structure, and depth so that content stays consistent as contributors change.

Training and Services Enablement

- Develop the training and enablement assets that accompany newly delivered functionality, including written guides, walkthroughs, and reference material for customer and internal audiences.

- Build the baseline materials, templates, and content standards that the Services team adapts and delivers for customer-specific training.

- Deliver internal enablement sessions for Services, Support, and Sales as significant functionality ships.

- Use support escalation and defect trends to identify where documentation or training gaps are generating avoidable customer friction, and close those gaps.

Implementation Templates and Standards

- Support the implementation templatization program led by the Director, Product and Delivery Enablement, which builds the out-of-the-box configuration, data, and documentation starting point that Services and customers deploy from.

- Own the documentation and content components of the standard package, and deliver assigned tasks within the program plan.

Launch Readiness and Adoption

- Maintain a launch readiness standard for customer-visible functionality, confirming that documentation, training assets, internal enablement, and release communication are complete before a release reaches customers.

- Track adoption of newly released functionality and report on it, so that the value of what we ship is visible.

What Success Looks Like in the First Year

- Stories and acceptance criteria reach development ready to build, with clarification cycles the exception rather than the norm.

- Release notes publish on a predictable cadence for every release, and published documentation matches shipped functionality.

- No significant functionality reaches customers without documentation, training assets, and internal enablement in place.

- Services and Support are equipped to deliver customer training from materials they did not have to build themselves.

- Adoption of newly released functionality is measured and reported on a regular cadence.

Required Qualifications

- Three or more years of experience in business analysis, product management, product commercialization, or a comparable role on a software product team.

- Two or more years as a member of an Agile team, ideally as a Business Analyst, Product Owner, or Scrum Master.

- Demonstrated experience authoring user stories and acceptance criteria that a development team built from.

- Experience working directly with business stakeholders and SMEs, and translating their needs into development-ready requirements.

- Demonstrated experience producing customer-facing content, such as product documentation, release notes, user guides, or training material.

- Strong written communication, with the range to write for developers, executives, and customers and adjust register accordingly.

- Working knowledge of the software development lifecycle and of Agile and Kanban practices.

- Proficiency with development planning tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, and Confluence.

- Comfortable using AI tools to draft, review, and maintain content.

- Comfortable working with product usage or support data to produce straightforward adoption and quality reporting.

- Professional, customer-facing communication style, with the poise to lead a working session or enablement session.

Preferred Qualifications

The right person will diagnose partner process friction, improve tool adoption, clarify ownership, strengthen partner attribution, and turn messy data into actionable insights that help the partner business grow.

The Partner Marketing Manager leads the strategy and execution of integrated marketing programs that grow OpenSesame's indirect business. This role activates priority partners installed bases and prospects, creates demand through partner-specific and vertical campaigns, and helps convert that demand into sales-accepted leads, qualified pipeline, and bookings.

The role collaborates closely with the Partners team, Sales, Product Marketing, Content, Field and Account-Based Marketing, and GTM Operations to connect partner priorities to scalable go-to-market programs and measurable business outcomes.

How you'll find success

While you are strategically capable, you love to roll up your sleeves and manage the details required to bring programs to life. You translate joint priorities into clear audiences, messages, campaigns, conversion paths, and measurable outcomes, actively driving the work from planning through execution and optimization.

You build trust with internal stakeholders and external partners, bring structure to a complex partner ecosystem, and maintain the judgment to prioritize high-impact work. You can set thoughtful boundaries around ad hoc requests and reshape activities that do not support shared business goals.

Success is measured by marketing-attributable indirect bookings generated through partner campaigns. Beyond delivering results, you will be seen as a critical collaborator across the Partners and Marketing teams, known for making priorities clearer, execution easier, and joint programs more effective.

What You'll Own

  • Indirect Funnel and Pipeline Generation: Plan, execute, and optimize marketing programs in alignment with partner overall annual and quarterly plans that generate partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline and bookings. Activate priority partners installed bases and prospects through co-marketing, account-based programs, vertical campaigns, email, webinars, events, marketplace motions, landing pages, and other channels. Manage applicable marketing development funds, including plans, utilization, compliance, and performance reporting.
  • Partner-Rep Activation and Marketing-in-a-Box: Equip Strategic Partner Managers (SPMs) and partner field teams with scalable campaigns, better-together messaging, campaign kits, events, target-account plays, engagement flows, product and launch communications, and clear referral pathways. Make it easy for partner representatives to identify opportunities, engage their audiences, and take the next action.
  • Bring the Partner Story to Life: Ensure OpenSesame s partner value and better-together stories are clearly and consistently represented across the company s marketing programs and channels. Collaborate with Product Marketing, Content, Field and ABM, and other teams to translate partner capabilities, launches, and customer value into compelling messaging, content, and market-facing experiences.

Track referral and non-referral leads, MQLs, SALs, opportunities, pipeline, sourced revenue, expansion revenue, engagement, and conversion rates by partner and program. Translate performance into clear optimization and investment decisions.

Apply AI to account and audience research, personalization, partner-specific content adaptation, campaign development, analysis, reporting, and workflow efficiency.

Specific performance targets will be established with leadership after the partner funnel baseline has been validated.

  • Strong troubleshooting skills across:
    • Linux operating systems

    • Networking

Top Three Outcomes for Year One

  • Develop a strong foundational knowledge of all Revinate products and what it takes to implement them from end-to-end.
  • Independently manage 25-35+ new mid-Level Strategic product implementation projects simultaneously. Successfully handle multiple aspects within larger contracts, running between 60-70+ Product Launch Objects.

  • Organize and lead effective internal and external project meetings, including scheduling and preparing necessary supplementary materials.
  • Manage all project documentation, including maintenance, updates, and distribution. Continuously create and refine internal Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) to enhance service quality and adapt to evolving product and process changes.
  • Serve as a subject matter expert for Revinates product suite, advising customers on maximizing the value of their services.
  • Commit to continuous learning across all facets of Revinate s products and services, building deep technical expertise related to integrations, software, systems, and product infrastructure.
  • Validate and ensure the correct implementation, integration, and intended functionality of all project technical components.
  • Execute and manage the technical setup and configuration of systems and solutions.
  • Resolve technical product issues encountered during implementation, often requiring hands-on back-end configuration and troubleshooting.
  • Actively pursue professional development, cross-training, and continuous learning to expand product and industry knowledge.
  • Act as a critical liaison between the customer and the internal product team, advocating for customer-requested enhancements to drive product improvement.
  • Perform thorough testing of product functionality and monitor relevant performance metrics, such as email deliverability, prior to project closure.
  • Coordinate with third-party Property Management System (PMS) vendors to acquire necessary technical details for integration.

What You'll Bring

  • Associate s Degree in a related field or a minimum of 2 years of professional experience in a Project Management role. Preference given to candidates with experience in customer-facing SaaS technology, Hotel Operations, or Hospitality Marketing.

  • Exceptional organizational skills and proven ability to prioritize tasks effectively under tight deadlines.
  • Strong technical aptitude, including the ability to rapidly acquire in-depth product knowledge necessary for diagnosing and resolving technical issues.
  • Experience collaborating with back-end engineering or integration teams to ensure seamless product and system functionality.
  • Proficiency with MS Office Suite; familiarity with Google Workspace (G-Suite), Zendesk / Jira, and Salesforce is a plus.
  • Working knowledge of various project management software and tools (e.g., Asana, Rocketlane).

Preferred Qualifications

  • Practical experience with technical SaaS software configuration and managing integrations.
  • Familiarity with hospitality systems, specifically Property Management Systems (PMS) such as Opera, roomMaster, or Maestro.

People Describe You As

  • A master communicator. You are highly effective at building rapport with customers and internal teams alike. You are a skilled, active listener and an efficient email correspondent, and you understand the value of proactive communication.
  • Flexible and fluid. You excel at managing multiple projects with unique needs, recognizing and applying patterns to drive efficiency. You thrive on finding innovative solutions to challenges as they arise.
  • Highly organized. You possess a methodical approach to work.

The ideal candidate brings strong hands-on People Operations experience, is comfortable independently managing complex operational matters, and can identify opportunities to improve processes and employee experience. You are organized, comfortable working with systems and data, and able to collaborate effectively across teams while navigating a fast-paced and ambiguous environment.

You will also contribute to improving operational efficiency, adopting automation and AI-enabled solutions, and driving consistent People Operations practices across the team.

Responsibilities

People Operations

  • Own key employee lifecycle processes including offboarding, role transitions, promotions, transfers, and other internal movements.
  • Manage employee requests and People Operations tickets, independently resolving complex queries and acting as an escalation point for operational issues within assigned areas.
  • Own recurring People Operations activities including leave and attendance management, localized benefits administration, payroll inputs and validations, employee documentation, and employment verification.
  • Support People Operations across India, the US, and EOR populations based on business requirements.
  • Maintain process documentation, SOPs, trackers, and controls to ensure consistent and reliable execution.
  • Own or contribute to People Operations projects and initiatives based on business priorities.

Process Improvement, Automation and Collaboration

  • Review operational data, SLA trends, recurring issues, and process gaps to identify and drive opportunities for improvement.
  • Improve People Operations processes and workflows to reduce manual effort, strengthen controls, and enhance operational efficiency and employee experience.
  • Partner with People Technology on HR system enhancements, integrations, testing, workflow changes, and automation initiatives.
  • Leverage AI and other technology solutions to streamline routine activities and improve operational efficiency while ensuring appropriate handling of employee and confidential data.
  • Partner with cross-functional teams including Payroll, Finance, IT, Talent Acquisition, Legal, and People Technology to resolve operational dependencies and improve processes.
  • Support the implementation and adoption of new or updated People systems, policies, and processes.

Data Management, Compliance and Reporting

  • Maintain the accuracy and integrity of employee data and lifecycle transactions across the HRIS and related People systems.
  • Conduct regular audits and reconciliations, identify data discrepancies or operational risks, and drive timely resolution.
  • Ensure assigned processes are executed in accordance with established SLAs, internal policies, controls, and applicable compliance requirements.
  • Support internal and external audits, compliance reporting, and data requests by providing accurate records and documentation.
  • Prepare and review recurring and ad hoc People Operations reports as required.

Experience / Education / Skills Required

  • Bachelor s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field.
  • 5 years of experience in People Operations, Employee Services, or a related HR function.
  • Strong working knowledge of employee lifecycle and core People Operations processes.
  • Hands-on experience with HRIS platforms such as Darwinbox, ADP, or similar systems.
  • Experience supporting India People Operations, along with experience or exposure to US and/or EOR operations.
  • Experience independently handling complex employee and operational matters with sound judgment and appropriate escalation.
  • Experience identifying and implementing process improvements, including the use of systems, automation, or workflow enhancements.
  • Comfortable adopting AI and emerging technologies to improve operational efficiency.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, organizational, and time-management skills with high attention to detail.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver against established timelines and SLAs.
  • Excellent interpersonal, written, and verbal communication skills with the ability to collaborate effectively across teams.
  • Demonstrated ability to handle sensitive and confidential information with professionalism and discretion.
  • Ability to work independently, navigate ambiguity, and make sound decisions within established policies and frameworks.
  • Proficiency in MS Office applications, Google Workspace, and collaboration tools such as Slack.
  • Experience working in a fast-paced SaaS, technology-driven, or globally distributed organization is highly preferred.

jobDescription:
Job Summary

Hello I am Servesh , Co- founder and CTO at Kayzen, and I am now looking for a Senior AI Engineer who will be part of our Engineering team. But wait, you have not heard of Kayzen before

You will work closely with our Console Engineering, Product and ML teams. Our Engineering organization builds and operates large-scale distributed systems, real-time bidding and budget systems, event and stream processing, data pipelines, and customer-facing products. For this role, the focus is practical: building AI-powered capabilities that become part of the Kayzen Console and are used in real production workflows.

Responsibilities

  • Architect, develop, and deploy production-grade LLM capabilities within the Kayzen Console
  • Build backend services, APIs, and integrations that connect AI capabilities with our product.
  • Contribute to product-facing and full-stack functionality where needed.
  • Implement production patterns for LLMs, RAG, embeddings, agents, and tool calling.
  • Build reusable components and abstractions where they improve engineering velocity and consistency.
  • Set up and improve evaluation, observability, monitoring, and feedback loops for AI features.
  • Monitor and optimize quality, latency, reliability, and inference cost.
  • Troubleshoot production issues and iterate based on telemetry and user feedback.
  • Work closely with Product, ML and Engineering to translate product problems into pragmatic AI solutions.
  • Prototype quickly, validate ideas, and turn successful experiments into maintainable production systems.

Requirements

Hands-on AI / LLM Experience

  • Hands-on experience building and shipping LLM-powered features to production.

Additional AI/LLM Requirements

  • Practical experience with RAG, embeddings, vector search and/or agentic systems.
  • Experience with LLM APIs and orchestration patterns; specific frameworks are less important than strong fundamentals.
  • Good understanding of production LLM concerns such as evaluation, observability, failure modes, cost and latency.
  • Experience iterating on AI features based on telemetry, evaluation results or user feedback.

Strong Software Engineering / Full-Stack Skills

  • Full-stack product development using Angular, JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, NodeJS etc. is a strong plus.
  • Strong experience designing APIs, services and production-grade systems.
  • Ability to write clean, maintainable code and take ownership from implementation through production.
  • Experience contributing across a product stack and willingness to work on both backend systems and user-facing product functionality.
  • Comfort working with AWS cloud infrastructure, CI/CD and production environments.

Product Startup Mindset

  • Bias for shipping, iteration and pragmatic problem solving.
  • Comfortable with ambiguity and rapid change.
  • Able to collaborate closely with Product, ML and Engineering stakeholders.
  • Can discuss trade-offs, challenge requirements constructively and translate AI complexity into practical product solutions.
  • Thinks in terms of maintainability and reuse rather than one-off demos.

Less About

  • Heavy model training or research.
  • Designing custom ML algorithms.
  • Academic optimization work.
  • Building proofs of concept that never reach production.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with multi-agent systems, tool calling or MCP.
  • Experience setting up guardrails, moderation and safety checks.
  • Experience with prompt/context management, routing, caching or fallback strategies.
  • Experience with Docker and cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP or Azure).
  • Experience with modern frontend development and customer-facing web applications.

descriptionFromApi:
The Community You Will Join

When you join Onehouse, youre joining a team of passionate professionals tackling the deeply technical challenges of building a 2-sided engineering product. Our engineering team serves as the bridge between the worlds of open source and enterprise: contributing directly to and growing Apache Hudi (already used at scale by global enterprises like Uber, Amazon, ByteDance etc) and concurrently defining a new industry category - the transactional data lake. The Data Infrastructure team is the grounding heartbeat to all of this. We live and breathe databases, building cornerstone infrastructure by working under Hudis hood to solving incredibly complex optimization and systems problems.

The Impact You Will Drive

  • As a foundational member of the Data Infrastructure team, you will productionize the next generation of our data tech stack by building the software and data features that actually process all of the data we ingest.
  • Accelerate our open source enterprise flywheel by working on the guts of Apache Hudis transactional engine and optimizing it for diverse Onehouse customer workloads.
  • Act as a SME to deepen our teams expertise on database internals, query engines, storage and/or stream processing.

A Typical Day

  • Design new concurrency control and transactional capabilities that maximize throughput for competing writers.
  • Design and implement new indexing schemes, specifically optimized for incremental data processing and analytical query performance.
  • Design systems that help scale and streamline metadata and data access from different query/compute engines.
  • Solve hard optimization problems to improve the efficiency (increase performance and lower cost) of distributed data processing algorithms over a Kubernetes cluster.
  • Leverage data from existing systems to find inefficiencies, and quickly build and validate prototypes.
  • Collaborate with other engineers to implement and deploy, safely rollout the optimized solutions in production.

What You Bring to the Table

  • Strong, object-oriented design and coding skills (Java and/or C/C++ preferably on a UNIX or Linux platform).
  • 5+ Years experience with inner workings of distributed (multi-tiered) systems, algorithms, and relational databases.
  • You embrace ambiguous/undefined problems with an ability to think abstractly and articulate technical challenges and solutions.
  • An ability to prioritize across feature development and tech debt with urgency and speed.
  • An ability to solve complex programming/optimization problems.
  • An ability to quickly prototype optimization solutions and analyze large/complex data.
  • Robust and clear communication skills.

Nice to Have

  • Experience working with database systems, Query Engines or Spark codebases.
  • Experience in optimization mathematics (linear programming, nonlinear optimization).
  • Existing publications of optimizing large-scale data systems in top-tier distributed system conferences.
  • PhD degree with 2+ years industry experience in solving and delivering high-impact optimization projects.

This role owns complex, ambiguous engineering problems within the team, driving technical quality and best practices across system design, scalable architecture, testing, reliability, and secure engineering spanning both the .NET/AWS-based Cloud API and our legacy 4D-based application. The ideal candidate brings strong enterprise application development experience, deep understanding of business logic–driven systems, solid relational database skills, and working familiarity with cloud infrastructure. jobDescription:
Channel Fusion is building an AI Factory focused on accelerating software delivery, automating business operations, modernizing legacy platforms, and creating intelligent customer-facing solutions through Agentic AI.

This is a hands-on implementation role. Rather than owning a single client program, this person builds and ships AI agents and automation across Channel Fusion's teams and client solutions wherever the Lead AI Platform Engineer and Field Product Managers identify agent opportunities. You'll work day-to-day alongside Suraj (AI Engineer) and under the direction of the Lead/Senior AI Platform Engineer, picking up implementation work as it's scoped and prioritized across programs.

This role does not set agent architecture standards or product requirements those come from the Lead AI Platform Engineer (how) and the relevant FPM (what). This role is the execution capacity that turns those specs into working, production-quality agents.


Role & responsibilities :-

What You Own

  • Implementation Build, test, and ship individual agents and automations to the architecture and standards set by the Lead AI Platform Engineer.
  • Cross-Team Delivery Pick up agent-building work across whichever Channel Fusion team or client solution has current priority, rather than owning one fixed program.
  • Peer Collaboration Work directly with Suraj and other AI engineers to share patterns, reusable components, and avoid duplicated effort across parallel implementations.
  • Quality & Testing — Write and maintain evals/tests for the agents you build so regressions are caught before they reach production.
  • Feedback Loop — Flag gaps, edge cases, or ambiguity in a spec back to the Lead/FPM rather than guessing silently.

Key Responsibilities

Agent Implementation

  • Build agents against specs handed down from the Lead AI Platform Engineer and FPMs — covering planning, tool use, and task execution.
  • Implement retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) components against enterprise knowledge sources.
  • Wire agents into internal and external business systems via secure APIs and data access patterns already established by the platform team.
  • Reuse and extend existing agent frameworks/libraries rather than building one-offs.

Cross-Program Delivery

  • Move across Channel Fusion client programs and internal workflows as implementation priorities shift.
  • Ramp quickly on a new program's data model and requirements with support from the assigned FPM.
  • Keep implementation consistent with patterns used elsewhere in the AI Factory, flagging when a program's needs don't fit existing patterns.

Quality, Testing & Operations

  • Write evaluation/test cases for agents before they ship.
  • Monitor and troubleshoot agents in production; escalate architecture-level issues to the Lead.
  • Track and report token/cost usage for agents you own.

Qualifications Required:-

  • 2+ years of professional software engineering experience.
  • Hands-on experience building or shipping at least one production AI-enabled application or agent.
  • Strong Python development skills.
  • Experience building and consuming REST APIs.
  • Working SQL skills and comfort with data integration across systems.
  • Experience with Git and collaborative development workflows.
  • Comfort moving across multiple codebases/programs rather than owning a single one.

Preferred — AI & Agentic Frameworks

  • LangGraph, CrewAI, Microsoft Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, OpenAI Agents Framework, Anthropic APIs, or Azure OpenAI Services.

Preferred — Cloud & Tooling

  • Azure (Functions, AI Services, AKS), Docker, CI/CD pipelines, GitHub Copilot or other AI-assisted development tools.

Preferred — Domain

  • Exposure to channel marketing, co-op advertising, dealer/distributor platforms, or document/PDF-heavy workflows (a current focus area for the team).
