descriptionFromApi:
Are you looking to work in the cutting edge area of applying data-science to help global customers get a better insight into their health? If so, read on and apply.


Role Name: Senior Data Scientist

Science Team | Full-Time | In-Office | Bangalore


The Role

The Ultrahuman Science Team builds the algorithms behind the Ring, M1 CGM, blood and urine biomarkers, and Performance Lab assessments. We are hiring a Senior Data Scientist to own those algorithms end to end: from the raw sensor signal to a model that is shipped, monitored, and trusted in users' hands.

This is a build role with real scope. In a typical month you will improve a production algorithm, root-cause a metric users are complaining about, and stand up the data pipeline the next model needs. The common thread is ownership: you take a vague question and return a working answer, without waiting to be handed scope.


What You'll Do

  • Own algorithms end to end: sleep staging, activity detection, sensor-derived metrics, and health scores. You frame the problem, build the features, train and evaluate the model, and see it live
  • Ship models, not notebooks: you prove a change on our own cohort before it reaches users, and a model is done only when it runs in production and you can tell how it is behaving
  • Validate against reference standards: design evaluations against gold standards, reference devices, and study ground truth, and know when a result is real and when it is an artifact
  • Own the data layer: cohort extraction, feature pipelines, study data, and raw sensor data, so the next model starts from clean inputs

What This Looks Like in Practice

1. Improving production algorithms - Take an existing production model like sleep staging, root-cause the failure modes against reference data, and ship a fix you can defend with numbers.

2. Building new models - Train an activity classifier on raw sensor data, design the labeled data collection that expands it, and pick the operating point so false positives never erode trust.

3. Proving it before it ships - Run a new steps algorithm against reference-device cohorts, decide with data when it is ready, and monitor how it behaves after rollout.


Who You Are

The two things we can't coach

  • High ownership, end to end: you take a problem from a vague question to a shipped model without waiting to be handed scope, and you can point to something you owned from raw data all the way to production
  • Hungry for more scope: you have outgrown your current role and want problems biggerthan your title, with the technical depth to be trusted with them

Also important

  • You've worked with human health data: wearables, physiological signals, or clinical data.

If your experience is close but not exact, show us why you will ramp fast

  • You've built at a startup: or somewhere small enough that nobody handed you clean data, clear specs, or a mature ML platform
  • You work like it's 2026: coding agents and AI tooling are part of how you build every day, and you can tell which new capabilities are worth adopting
  • You communicate: you can explain a model and its limits to a product manager, an engineer, or a founder, and hold your own with our scientists Core Technical Skills
  • Languages and data: Python and SQL daily, comfortable working in a real codebase
  • Machine learning: PyTorch or TensorFlow, scikit-learn, and gradient boosting, with the judgment to know which the problem needs
  • Advanced machine learning: time series and sequence models, deep learning on continuous physiological signals, and ensembles
  • Statistics and evaluation: hypothesis testing, experiment and A/B design, model evaluation, and error analysis against a reference standard
  • Scale and cloud: Spark or equivalent on large datasets, and AWS, GCP, or Azure
  • Production ML and MLOps: training pipelines, model versioning, deployment, monitoring, and drift detection
  • LLMs and agentic systems: fine-tuning and serving models, building agentic pipelines, and using coding agents to move faster

Experience:

- 4 to 5 years building and shipping machine learning systems. We index on what you have shipped and on trajectory, not the exact number of years; if you are a little earlier but have clearly outgrown your current scope, we want to hear from you.

- Bachelor's or higher in engineering, computer science, statistics, or a related field.


How We Work and Who Thrives Here

- The Science team is small and moves fast, and much of the work has no precedent to copy.

- People do their best work here when they are energized by ambiguity, low on ego, quick to adopt a better idea no matter where it comes from, and comfortable owning something before anyone has told them how. If you need a mature data org, clean labelled datasets, and clear guardrails to thrive, this particular role will not be the right fit, and that is worth knowing up front.


What You'll Gain

  • Ownership of algorithms that hundreds of thousands of people see every morning
  • A dataset most scientists never get to touch: 100M+ nights of sleep and continuous physiological signals at scale
  • Direct collaboration with the engineering, product, and design teams building Ultrahuman

Role & responsibilities

We are hiring an applied AI Engineer to build and harden the AI layer of an enterprise compliance platform on Azure OpenAI and Microsoft Power Platform. This is hands-on Azure OpenAI engineering: wiring and hardening LLM calls, enforcing structured output, building the vision path for scanned documents, and tuning document classification to a measured accuracy bar.

Please read this before applying: this is an applied LLM integration and prompt-engineering role. It does not involve training models from scratch, large-scale MLOps, or statistical modelling. We are looking for engineers who ship reliable, auditable AI features on Azure OpenAI, not research profiles.


Key Responsibilities

  • Build and harden Azure OpenAI (GPT-5o text and vision) integrations: deployments, api-version, quota, and chat completions.

  • Engineer prompts for strict structured output: JSON-only contracts, schema validation, deterministic field extraction, and no invented facts.
  • Build a lightweight evaluation harness to measure document-classification accuracy against a labelled dataset, tune the confidence threshold, and iterate in measured cycles to meet the accuracy target.

title: Forward Deployed AI Engineer (Voice AI Experience)
jobDescription:
About the Role

At Hero Vired, we are building AI-powered learning experiences that redefine higher education and professional upskilling. We are looking for a highly motivated Forward Deployed Engineer (AI/ML) who can work at the intersection of AI, engineering, and business to design, deploy, and scale AI-driven solutions across our products and internal business functions.


As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you will collaborate closely with Product Managers, Engineering, Data Science, and business stakeholders to understand real-world challenges, rapidly prototype AI

solutions, and deploy production-ready applications using modern AI and Machine Learning technologies. This role requires a combination of strong software engineering skills, practical experience with Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and the ability to translate business requirements into scalable AI solutions.


Responsibilities

  • Embed with customers to design, build, and deploy voice AI and search solutions end to end.
  • Scope customer use cases gather requirements, map their data and systems, and define success metrics.
  • Build and deploy voice AI solutions (conversational agents, STT/TTS/telephony pipelines, realtime streaming), and tune them for latency and quality.
  • Design and implement search and retrieval systems (RAG, semantic and hybrid search, re rankers) over customer data and knowledge bases.
  • Own end-to-end delivery: prototype, integrate, deploy, tune, and hand off.
  • Integrate solutions with customer systems (CRMs, telephony, databases, APIs, and webhooks).
  • Debug and optimize deployments in production (latency, accuracy, reliability, and cost).
  • Run POCs and pilots, and iterate rapidly on customer feedback.
  • Serve as the technical point of contact and translate business needs into technical solutions.
  • Feed field learnings back into the core product and build reusable tooling from recurring patterns.
  • Onboard and train customer teams on the deployed solutions.

Requirements

  • Strong hands-on software engineering experience (Python and/or Node.js / TypeScript).
  • Hands-on experience with voice AI speech-to-text, text-to-speech, real-time / streaming audio, telephony, and latency optimization.
  • Experience building search and retrieval systems — embeddings, vector search, RAG, re rankers, and hybrid (semantic + keyword) search.
  • Experience with LLM application development — prompt engineering, tool / function calling, and agent orchestration.
  • Proficiency in REST APIs / GraphQL, and integrating third-party systems (webhooks, data pipelines).
  • Experience with databases (SQL and NoSQL).
  • Hands-on experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and debugging in production.
  • Solid understanding of system design and architecture.
  • Strong problem-solving and debugging skills.

Leadership and Soft Skills

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management — able to run technical conversations with both engineers and business owners.
  • Strong customer-facing presence, with the ability to build trust and manage expectations.
  • Ownership mindset with a bias for shipping and end-to-end delivery.
  • Comfort with ambiguity, rapid iteration, and adapting to each customer's context.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Prior experience as a Forward Deployed Engineer, solutions engineer, or in implementation / delivery / sales engineering.
  • Familiarity with agent orchestration frameworks (LangGraph, CrewAI, Temporal, Google ADK, or AG2).
  • Familiarity with vector databases and search infrastructure (Qdrant, Pinecone, Weaviate, Elasticsearch / OpenSearch).
  • Exposure to voice / telephony platforms (Deepgram, ElevenLabs, Telnyx, or similar).
  • Indic / multilingual (Hindi / Hinglish) voice or search experience.
  • Domain background in sales-tech, EdTech, or conversational AI.
  • Experience turning customer deployments into reusable frameworks and tooling.
  • Prior experience in Agile / Scrum environments.
  • Open-source contributions or technical blogging.

We are looking for a GenAI Engineer with hands-on experience in Generative AI and/or Agentic AI to design and develop enterprise-grade AI solutions. The ideal candidate should have strong Python development skills and experience with modern LLM/agent frameworks. You will work closely with product and engineering teams to take GenAI use cases from prototype to production.


Roles & Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and deploy Generative AI and Agentic AI applications using LLMs and modern AI frameworks.

  • Integrate LLMs such as OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, or equivalent models into enterprise applications.
  • Develop and integrate LLM tools, APIs, and external services to enable agent-driven workflows.
  • Implement prompt engineering, context management, structured outputs, and guardrails.
  • Build scalable Python-based APIs and backend services for GenAI applications.
  • Evaluate and optimize LLM applications for accuracy, latency, cost, reliability, and hallucination reduction.
  • Implement observability and evaluation using tools such as LangSmith, MLflow, or equivalent.
  • Collaborate with product, engineering, and business teams to translate use cases into production-ready AI solutions.
  • Deploy GenAI solutions using cloud, Docker, CI/CD, and modern software engineering practices.

Requirements

  • Mandatory hands-on experience in Generative AI or Agentic AI development.
  • Strong programming experience in Python.
  • Hands-on experience with LLMs and LLM application development.
  • Experience with LangChain, LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI, or similar agent frameworks.
  • Strong understanding of RAG architecture, embeddings, vector databases, and semantic search.
  • Experience with AI agents, tool/function calling, agent orchestration, and multi-step workflows.
  • Strong knowledge of prompt engineering and LLM context management.
  • Experience integrating LLM APIs and third-party APIs/services.
  • Experience developing REST APIs and production-grade backend services.
  • Understanding of LLM evaluation, hallucination mitigation, guardrails, and responsible AI practices.
  • Experience with at least one cloud platform AWS, Azure, or GCP.
  • Good understanding of Git, Docker, CI/CD, testing, and software engineering best practices.

Good to Have

  • Experience with multi-agent systems.
  • Experience with MCP (Model Context Protocol).
  • Experience with fine-tuning / LoRA / model customization.
  • Experience with Azure AI / AWS Bedrock / Google Vertex AI.
  • Experience with Pinecone, FAISS, Weaviate, Chroma, Milvus, or similar vector databases.
  • Experience with LLM observability and evaluation frameworks.
  • Experience building enterprise GenAI solutions in production.

Forward Deployed AI Engineer – LLM & AI Automation
Telesat is looking for a Forward Deployed AI Engineer (FDE) to help bring AI from prototypes into real-world engineering environments.
In this role, you’ll work closely with system test engineers, automation teams, QA, and software development teams to identify opportunities for AI, build practical solutions, and make them reliable enough for production use.
This is a hands-on engineering role for someone who enjoys solving ambiguous problems, working closely with users, and turning AI capabilities into measurable improvements in engineering productivity.

What You'll Do

AI Deployment & Automation
  • Take LLM and Generative AI prototypes and turn them into production-ready, repeatable solutions.
  • Integrate AI solutions with existing engineering applications, automation frameworks, APIs, and workflows.
  • Build orchestration and integration logic across multiple systems using Python.
  • Deploy, monitor, troubleshoot, and continuously improve AI-powered solutions.

AI in System Test Automation
You’ll work directly with system test and automation teams to:
  • Understand real-world testing workflows, constraints, and failure modes.
  • Identify areas where AI can safely reduce manual effort and improve productivity.
  • Adapt AI workflows to work with existing automation frameworks, test data, schemas, and configurations.
  • Develop AI-powered workflows that assist with generating structured test assets.
  • Use real test results and failure analysis to continuously improve AI behavior.

Agentic AI
  • Implement and customize agentic AI workflows for engineering and test automation use cases.
  • Develop AI workflows that can interpret requirements, schemas, and models.
  • Tune prompts, instructions, and AI behavior based on real-world outcomes.
  • Build validation and guardrails to improve the accuracy, reliability, and safety of AI outputs.
  • Diagnose and resolve AI-related issues in live engineering environments.

Collaboration & Problem Solving
  • Work closely with engineers and end users to understand their challenges and workflows.
  • Rapidly iterate on solutions based on real-world feedback.
  • Debug complex software and AI issues across multiple systems.
  • Help engineering teams identify practical and high-value opportunities for AI adoption.

Required Qualifications
  • 2+ years of hands-on experience in software engineering, applied AI, or a related field.
  • Strong hands-on Python development experience.
  • Experience deploying LLM / Generative AI applications beyond the prototype stage and into real-world or production environments.
  • Experience integrating AI solutions with enterprise applications, automation frameworks, APIs, or other software systems.
  • Demonstrated experience taking an AI or automation solution from prototype to real-world usage.
  • Experience troubleshooting and improving AI behavior, including:
    • Prompt/instruction tuning
    • Output validation
    • Guardrails
    • Failure analysis
    • Diagnosing inaccurate or low-quality outputs
  • Strong software engineering, debugging, and problem-solving skills.
  • Experience working closely with engineers or end users and iterating solutions based on live feedback.
  • Experience with REST APIs, Git, CI/CD, and at least one major cloud platform such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.

Nice to have experience with:

  • Linux
  • Docker
  • Kubernetes
  • Test automation frameworks
  • System or network testing environments.

You'll help Telesat's engineering teams:

  • Automate complex workflows.
  • Improve the speed and quality of system testing.
  • Turn promising AI prototypes into dependable production solutions.
  • Establish practical and responsible ways of using Agentic AI in engineering environments.

Each transaction is a signal. Who the customer is. What they bought. When they’re likely to come back. What would bring them back sooner.

Most of that signal goes unused across the retail industry — and honestly, we haven’t extracted all of it either.

Your job is to build the things that turn those signals into revenue: for our merchants, and for us.

WHAT THIS ROLE IS

Not growth marketing. Not backend engineering. Something in between that most companies don’t hire for.

You’ll find problems, build solutions, ship them fast, measure whether they worked, and either kill them or scale them.


Discover Build Experiment Measure Iterate

You’ll have enough engineering ability to build things yourself, without waiting for a sprint slot. And enough curiosity about the business to pick the right things to build.

WHAT YOU’D ACTUALLY WORK ON

Real examples of problems sitting on our list right now:

  • Merchant activation. A retailer signs up but never runs their first campaign. Why? Find the drop-off, build something that fixes it, measure whether activation moves.
  • AI agents for retail ops. A merchant asks “which customers haven’t visited in 60 days and spend above 5,000?” — and gets an answer, not a dashboard to navigate.
  • Segmentation and lifecycle automation. Build the engine that decides which customer gets which message, when, on WhatsApp — across thousands of stores with very different buying cycles.
  • New products. Some of what we’ll be selling in two years doesn’t exist yet. Take a hunch about where retail is going, build a working version of it, put it in front of merchants, and find out if you were right.
  • Internal leverage. Sales, onboarding and support run on manual work that shouldn’t be manual. Automate it, and the whole company moves faster.
  • Growth surfaces. Interactive calculators, self-serve onboarding, in-product prompts — things that generate qualified interest without a sales rep in the loop.

You won’t do all of these. You’ll pick up whatever is most broken or most valuable at the time.

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

  • 2–5 years of hands-on engineering. You can ship to production without supervision.
  • Strong fundamentals over specific frameworks — we care more about how you think than what you’ve used.
  • A builder’s instinct: you see a problem and reach for a prototype, not a document.
  • Comfort with ambiguity. Most of what you work on won’t arrive as a written spec.
  • Genuine interest in why something matters commercially, not just how it works technically.
  • Willingness to kill your own ideas when the data says so.
  • Curiosity that pulls you outside your current stack.

You don’t need retail or SaaS experience. You do need to be the kind of person who gets restless watching someone do something manually for the fifth time.

HOW WE BUILD

AI is not a side experiment here — it’s part of the daily workflow.

We use Claude Code, Cursor, Codex and similar agents as force multipliers. That means you should be able to:

  • Give an agent enough context and constraints to produce something useful
  • Review, challenge and debug what it produces
  • Use it to move fast through unfamiliar codebases and technologies
  • Know when to stop using it, because deterministic engineering is the better answer

We’re wary of two failure modes: engineers who won’t use AI, and engineers who ship whatever it produces.

STACK

You won’t know all of this. You should be able to pick up most of it.

Backend


Node.js, TypeScript, Express / NestJS, REST APIs, webhooks, event-driven systems

Frontend


React, Next.js, responsive UI

Data


MySQL / PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, data modelling, query optimisation

AI


LLM APIs, function calling, RAG, agents, prompt engineering

Infrastructure


AWS, Linux, Docker, CI/CD, production debugging

THINGS WORTH KNOWING BEFORE YOU APPLY

We’d rather you self-select out now than three months in.

  • Schedule. Monday–Friday in office, Saturday from home. It’s a six-day week. Sundays are yours.
  • Ambiguity is the default. You will regularly be handed a problem, not a solution. If that sounds stressful rather than interesting, this isn’t the role.
  • Cross-functional by force. You’ll talk to sales, ops and merchants. You’ll be on calls that aren’t about code.
  • Some of what you build will be thrown away. That’s the point of experiments. If you get attached to your work, it will hurt.
  • Small team, wide surface area. Real ownership, but also less structure than a larger company.

ABOUT BILLFREE

Billfree Labs builds the post-purchase layer for offline retail.

Retailers already have billing software. It records what happened. We connect to it and help them use what happened — customer profiles, digital bills, loyalty, feedback, Google Reviews, WhatsApp campaigns, retention automation — to influence what happens next.


The bill shouldn’t end the customer relationship. It should start the next one.

We work with [X]+ businesses across India today.

HIRING PROCESS

1. Intro call — 30 minutes, mutual fit.

2. Technical conversation — walk us through something you’ve built end-to-end.

3. Build round — a real problem from our backlog, take-home or paired, your choice.

4. Final round — with leadership, on how you think about problems and outcomes.

We aim to close within two weeks of the first call.

Compensation : depending on experience.

TO APPLY

Send your CV to hr@billfree.in & call us at 9871993509— and one paragraph on something you built because it annoyed you that it didn’t exist.

That paragraph matters more to us than the CV.

  • Rapid Learning Agility: A demonstrated track record of quickly mastering complex, specialized domain knowledge (e.g., financial methodologies, regulatory frameworks, or proprietary rating logic).

mart/gold layers). This platform will orchestrate complex data workflows and scalable ELT

pipelines to integrate data from enterprise systems such as PeopleSoft, D2L, and

Salesforce, delivering high-quality, governed data for machine learning, AI/BI, and analytics

backbone for strategic decision-making, predictive modeling, and innovation.

Medallion Architecture principles.

transform raw (bronze) data into trusted curated (silver) and analytics-ready (gold) data

layers.

• Operationalize Databricks Workflows for orchestration, dependency management, and

pipeline automation.

• Apply schema evolution and data versioning to support agile data development.

2. Platform Integration & Data Ingestion:

• Connect and ingest data from enterprise systems such as PeopleSoft, D2L, and

Salesforce using APIs, JDBC, or other integration frameworks.

structured, and unstructured data.

• Design standardized data ingestion processes with automated error handling, retries,

and alerting.

• Develop data quality checks, validation rules, and anomaly detection mechanisms to

ensure data integrity across all layers.

• Integrate monitoring and observability tools (e.g., Databricks metrics, Grafana) to track

ETL performance, latency, and failures.

• Implement Unity Catalog or equivalent tools for centralized metadata management, data

lineage, and governance policy enforcement.

4. Security, Privacy, and Compliance:

• Enforce data security best practices including row-level security, encryption at rest/in

transit, and fine-grained access control via Unity Catalog.

• Design and implement data masking, tokenization, and anonymization for compliance

with privacy regulations (e.g., GDPR, FERPA).

• Work with security teams to audit and certify compliance controls.


5. AI/ML-Ready Data Foundation:

• Enable data scientists by delivering high-quality, feature-rich data sets for model training

and inference.

• Support AIOps/MLOps lifecycle workflows using MLflow for experiment tracking, model

registry, and deployment within Databricks.

• Collaborate with AI/ML teams to create reusable feature stores and training pipelines.

• Architect and manage data lakes on Azure Data Lake Storage (ADLS) or Amazon S3,

and design ingestion pipelines to feed the bronze layer.

• Build data marts and warehousing solutions using platforms like Databricks.

• Optimize data storage and access patterns for performance and cost-efficiency.

7. Documentation & Enablement:

• Maintain technical documentation, architecture diagrams, data dictionaries, and

runbooks for all pipelines and components.

• Provide training and enablement sessions to internal stakeholders on the Databricks

platform, Medallion Architecture, and data governance practices.

• Conduct code reviews and promote reusable patterns and frameworks across teams.

• Submit a weekly schedule of hours worked and progress reports outlining completed

tasks, upcoming plans, and blockers.

• Track deliverables against roadmap milestones and communicate risks or

dependencies.

data engineering.

• Deep understanding of ELT pipeline development, orchestration, and monitoring in

cloud-native environments.

• Experience implementing Medallion Architecture (Bronze/Silver/Gold) and working with

data versioning and schema enforcement in enterprise grade environments.

into centralized data platforms.

networking aspects.

Job Summary

All roles at JumpCloud are Remote unless otherwise specified in the Job Description.

Role Overview

As a Software Engineer II on the Auth Access team, you will contribute to building, scaling, and maintaining the core authentication and identity services that power the JumpCloud platform. You will work closely with a globally distributed engineering team to deliver reliable features across our Go, Python, and Node.js backend stacks.

This role focuses heavily on implementing modern, secure web authentication protocols, integrating seamless identity workflows, and aggressively leveraging AI-assisted development tools (like GitHub Copilot and Cursor) to write high-quality code and accelerate feature velocity.

What You Will Do

  • Backend Development: Develop, test, and deploy scalable, secure, and well-documented microservices using Go, Python, and/or Node.js.
  • Auth Identity Implementation: Write and maintain backend code supporting core Auth/IAM technologies, including OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect (OIDC), JSON Web Tokens (JWT), and single sign-on (SSO) flows.
  • AI-Driven Efficiency: Actively utilize AI-assisted development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Cursor) to automate code generation, write robust automated unit tests, and speed up debugging cycles.
  • Cloud Infrastructure: Work with containerized applications using Docker and Kubernetes, and deploy cloud-native services across AWS Cloud Services (EC2, S3, Lambda, DynamoDB).
  • Quality Automation: Design automated test cases for both new features and legacy services, utilizing CI/CD pipelines to enforce automated quality gates.
  • Collaborative Engineering: Partner with product managers and senior engineers across multiple time zones to refine requirements, assess technical feasibility, and participate in thorough code reviews.

What We're Looking For

  • Experience: 3-5 years of professional experience in software development, with a strong emphasis on backend systems and API development.
  • Core Technical Stack: Proficiency in Go, Node.js, and/or Python.

Application Engineer II

As an Application Engineer II in our Product Area, you will contribute to the development of a modern lakehouse architecture build on Azure Datalake using Python to implement business services. You will design, develop, automate, and support backend applications that combine data elements from multiple domains and systems. You will leverage innovative technologies and frameworks to enable scalable and efficient processing. You will collaborate with other engineers, analysts, product owners and stakeholders to deliver value-added solutions that meet the business needs and expectations.

Key tasks

  • Understand business requirements and convert them into technical specifications
  • Hands-on coding in Python /PySpark
  • Oversee the end-to-end application architecture
  • Drive the design and build of business services that create financial data by combining input from various sources
  • Take ownership for the implementation of functional and non-functional requirements. Ensure a high level of test automation
  • Peer reviews
  • Foster sustainable relationships and become a trusted partner to team members.
  • Meet with stakeholders, understand the requirements, and advise on efficient solutions
  • Ensure timely customer communication and coordination of follow-up activities
  • Apply and implement Agile Scrum and DevOps standard methodologies
  • Contribute to the operations during quarterly closing cycles

  • Collaborate with other team members to develop the software products within the team's scope.
  • Design and implement data transformation services and data flows.
  • Collaborate with other engineers in the team to ensure design decisions are aligned.
  • Perform peer code reviews
  • Present and communicate ideas and designs to various stakeholder for review and brainstorming
  • Ensure technical design and implementation are in line with the application architecture and meet quality requirements (e.g., performance, reliability, availability)

About the team

  • The Estimated Cashflow Preparation team is a growing engineering team within the Subledger Input Preparation Product Area, focused on building the next generation of finance data and processing services
  • The Product Owner and Engineering Manager who are based in Zurich and lead a team that operates from Zurich and Hyderabad

  • Bachelor's or master's degree in a relevant quantitative field, e.g. Computer Science, Mathematics, Engineering or other equivalent
  • 6+ years of experience in designing and implementing reliable and scalable software through the full software development lifecycle using modern IDEs, code management and automation tools. Hands-on experience with test driven development
  • Strong understanding of software engineering techniques with modern programming languages and analytical frameworks. Proficient in Python, PySpark, SQL
  • Profound experience in Spark based data lake extended services like, Azure Databricks, Azure Data Factory, Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2 and Delta Lake

  • Expertise working with relational databases like Oracle/Postgres
  • Experience with Integration technologies like REST/SOAP APIs
  • Experience working with AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot is considered an advantage.
  • Problem-solving skills and commitment to quality and timely delivery
  • Strong interpersonal, written, and verbal communication skills
  • A desire to continuously upskill stay relevant with emerging technologies

Experience Level

Senior Level

  • Solid understanding of emerging methodologies, including AEO (Answer Engine Optimization), GEO (Generative Engine Optimization), and AI content/search optimizations.
  • Practical understanding of technical audits, Schema markup, Core Web Vitals, and semantic on-page optimizations.

Insurity's Next Interfaces Administrator will be the go-to specialist for our AI-enabled integrations and automations, ensuring critical workflows, agents, and data flows run reliably every day. You'll monitor and troubleshoot interfaces and AI agents, document and improve runbooks, and turn business needs into practical automations using tools like Copilot/Claude and Python or PowerShell. Job Summary

Were looking for a Social Media Organic Growth Specialist to build and scale our organic brand presence across social media platforms and YouTube. This is a hands-on role for someone who understands social-first storytelling, internet culture, content strategy, and community building.

Beyond creating engaging content, youll be responsible for developing content IPs (recurring formats, series, and shows) that audiences recognize, return to, and share. Youll also leverage your understanding of SEO, AEO (Answer Engine Optimization), and Online Reputation Management (ORM) to ensure every piece of content strengthens the brands visibility across search engines, AI answer platforms, and online conversations.

Your primary focus will be organic growth driving reach, engagement, brand awareness, and audience loyalty without relying heavily on paid media.

Key Responsibilities

  • Social Media Organic Growth
    • Own the day-to-day management of the brands social media channels, including Instagram, LinkedIn, X, YouTube, and emerging platforms.
    • Develop and execute content calendars aligned with business, marketing, and brand objectives.
    • Create, curate, and publish engaging content across formats including posts, carousels, reels, stories, shorts, and videos.
    • Produce content designed to earn organic reach, engagement, and shares rather than simply maintaining a posting schedule.
    • Stay on top of platform trends, memes, creator formats, and algorithm updates, adapting them creatively while maintaining the brand voice.
    • Write compelling, platform-native copy and captions.
    • Build and nurture an active community by responding to comments, messages, and conversations in a timely and authentic manner.
  • YouTube Growth Content IP Development
    • Own and grow the brands YouTube presence across both long-form content and Shorts.
    • Conceptualize, launch, and scale recurring content IPs, series, and shows that build audience loyalty and brand recall.
    • Collaborate with presenters, editors, designers, and production teams to maintain consistency in quality, publishing cadence, and format identity.
    • Optimize titles, thumbnails, descriptions, chapters, and metadata to maximize discoverability and audience retention.
    • Analyze content performance to identify winning formats, double down on successful content, and continuously iterate on underperforming concepts.
  • SEO, AEO Search Visibility
    • Apply SEO and Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) best practices across social and video content to improve discoverability on Google Search, YouTube, Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Perplexity, and other AI-powered search experiences.
    • Optimize metadata, descriptions, keywords, transcripts, and content structure for long-term organic visibility.
    • Collaborate with the SEO and Content teams to align social content with strategic keyword and topic priorities.

    • Monitor conversations and public sentiment across social platforms, Reddit, Quora, review sites, and community forums.
    • Identify emerging negative narratives or reputation risks and escalate them to the appropriate stakeholders.
    • Ensure organic content consistently reinforces an authentic, trustworthy, and positive brand narrative.

    • Run structured content experiments with clear hypotheses, success metrics, and documented learnings.
    • Develop repeatable playbooks around high-performing formats and growth strategies.
    • Collaborate closely with Design, Content, Marketing, and Product teams to align organic initiatives with larger campaigns and launches.
    • Support product launches, campaigns, and announcements through strategic organic amplification.

  • Excellent copywriting skills with a strong understanding of platform-specific tone and voice.
  • Strong awareness of internet culture, trends, and emerging content formats.

  • Familiarity with AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, and other AI-powered content and research tools.

  • A creative thinker with a strong understanding of internet culture and digital storytelling.
  • Someone who thinks beyond individual posts and builds scalable content systems and recurring formats.
  • A highly proactive individual with strong ownership and execution skills.
  • Detail-oriented with excellent organizational and project management abilities.
